source.observed: Two-step bulk storage solicitation; eligibility precedes invited bids.

evidence_gaps: Confirm authoritative solicitation deadline: release says Thursday December 15, 2026, which is Tuesday.
Obtain program manual and project eligibility assessment.
Validate bid costs, timing, qualification odds and award-conditional project valuation.
limitations: All probabilities, costs and project value are assumptions; no calibrated forecast.
Project value is decision-date NPV net of all project costs, excluding application spending; not subsidy revenue.
No ISC settlement, safety certification or legal eligibility determination.
Timing effect on award odds is an explicit relative haircut; no claim that staging preserves competitiveness.
